answer: Put court filing hash with clerk attestation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the basalt here is verification, the river of cost is what stops the farm, and the fable of the record keeps every claim checkable. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
